_comment: Spymaster registry config (docs/iteration-architecture.md step 2, codenames/spymasters/registry.py). Each entry names a Spymaster subclass (see SPYMASTER_CLASSES) and its constructor params. 'trained' marks whether this entry expects a trained artifact before it can be built -- false for every entry here, since none of them train. 'roles' says which scripts pick an entry up without naming it: 'baseline' is the standard comparison set (both arenas), 'exploration' is only offered by scripts/pipeline/run_two_team_arena.py. A new entry omitting 'roles' defaults to ['baseline'], so it appears in the arenas automatically.

spymasters._comment: Clue search against the distilled listener (cache/listener_gbt.txt) scored by codenames/pl_reward.py, derived in docs/clue-selection-learned.tex. Two-stage: expected_words shortlists the clue pool with its Gaussian model (extract() is ~750us/clue, so scoring all 11,145 would be ~8.4s per turn), then the listener rescores the top `shortlist`. `sigma` tunes ONLY that shortlisting pass and has no effect on the final ranking -- it is set to 1.5 rather than the baseline's 2.5 because the sigma ladder found 1.5 the better value and the first stage's job is recall, not order. The listener is fitted to gpt-oss-120b, so evaluating against Sonnet is a transfer test, not a self-evaluation.
spymasters.name: learned_listener
